programme.desc: Plans for a dinner at an Iranian restaurant get canceled, leading Dhruv and Kavya to attend a friend's house party. The night evolves into an unexpected adventure, ending at a local fair.

programme.title: Here We Go!
programme.desc: During a visit to a vineyard, Dhruv and Kavya open up about their insecurities and future aspirations, leading to deeper conversations about life and their relationship.

programme.title: Masterji
programme.desc: Kishore, an orphan has only one dream, to join the IndianArmy. When he gets thrown out of his orphanage, Masterji, an ex-army officer who left the army and is now working as a tailor, reluctantly adopts him. The khadoos Masterji and Kishore have only two things in common, their dream to serve the nation and their lonely lives. Will Masterji help Kishore achieve his own unfulfilled dreams to become a soldier, and will Kishore find a father in Masterji?

programme.title: Donning
programme.desc: A month into their studies, the trio struggles to balance an overwhelming syllabus, challenging practicals, and the desire to enjoy college life. An unexpected revelation about Nishant changes the group's dynamics.

programme.title: Jaldi Lautna, Captain
programme.desc: Captain Vikrant Sahay and his wife Vibha had a beautiful love story. But Vikrant’s sudden death in battle leaves the otherwise happy-go-lucky Vibha completely shocked. Unable to deal with Vikrant’s death, Vibha decides that the best way to honor him is to fulfill his dream, by joining the army herself, much against her family’s wishes. Will Vibha succeed and make her late husband, her family, and the country proud?

programme.title: Patient Zero
programme.desc: Midterm results bring surprises, prompting celebrations that uncover deeper issues the friends must confront together.

programme.title: Shooter Jawan
programme.desc: Tribhuvan, a dedicated Indian Army Officer comes across a young sweeper Tinku, who is a gifted shooter. Tribhuvan knows Tinku has a rare talent, and wants to enroll him in the shooting academy and then the Indian Army. However, owing to Tinku’s caste, his father is afraid of society’s taunts and is completely against this career choice. Will Tinku have the courage to fight back and rise above ‘log kya kahenge’?

programme.title: Lockdown
programme.desc: Huma faces a crisis of confidence, seeking unconventional advice to regain her footing. A heartbreaking event forces the friends to reevaluate their priorities and the strength of their bond.

programme.title: Sarhad Ke Baad Bhi
programme.desc: Colonel Balram, a retired Indian Army Officer, returns home after several years of service, only to find himself completely disconnected from his son Aman. While Balram is failing at mending his relationship with Aman, he is also silently struggling with mental health issues, because of his days at war. Will Aman ever understand his father’s sacrifices for the country or will it be too late before he realises just how much his father loves him?

programme.title: Critical Condition
programme.desc: As final exams approach, Huma contemplates unethical shortcuts, leading to revelations that challenge perceptions and test the integrity of their friendship.

programme.title: Veera
programme.desc: Veera’s martyred father’s last wish was for her to join the Indian armed forces. But Veera is not for it. The bravery and patriotism that the country remembers and celebrates him for, are the same things that took Veera’s father away from her. She’s been carrying this anger and hurt in her heart for too long, until she discovers a hidden letter.

programme.title: Bachelorhood
programme.desc: Viraj and Arjun have been best friends since childhood. While Viraj loves his bachelor life and wants Arjun to move in as his flatmate, Arjun has other plans of ‘settling down’. What happens when this bachelor reveals he wants to be ‘unbachelored?’

programme.title: Fomo
programme.desc: Dhruv and Kavya plan a lazy Sunday but feel the pressure of missing out when they see their friends enjoying exciting activities on social media. This leads them to seek ways to spice up their day.

programme.title: Kabab Mein Haddi
programme.desc: The gang gets together to celebrate Arjun’s big news, but Viraj is concerned whether the dynamics of the group will change with its new addition. Will Khushi win over the gang and get Viraj's stamp of approval?

programme.title: Have A Nice Day
programme.desc: A morning rush to work results in a tussle between Dhruv and Kavya, spoiling their moods. Throughout the day, they attempt to make amends, highlighting the irony and sweetness of their relationship.

programme.title: (un)happy Birthday
programme.desc: Its Arjun’s birthday, and Khushi steals the limelight with her unconventional celebration party. Tensions at the party rise when Viraj confronts Arjun about his change in behaviour since he started dating Khushi. Will Arjun pick pyaar or dosti?

programme.title: Good Night
programme.desc: A sleepless night due to mosquitoes leads to the discovery that Kavya's ex-boyfriend is getting married, prompting a long conversation about their past relationships.

programme.title: Mann Ki Rant
programme.desc: The group tries to resolve tensions between Viraj and Arjun, but they both resist. As Viraj rants to Zara and Kaka about his friendships and relationships, he realises more about his true self.

programme.title: Thank You!
programme.desc: Plans for a dinner at an Iranian restaurant get canceled, leading Dhruv and Kavya to attend a friend's house party. The night evolves into an unexpected adventure, ending at a local fair.

programme.title: Yaar Ki Shaadi
programme.desc: The wedding day is here! Will Viraj stand by Arjun on the most important day of his life, and will he admit his true feelings to a special someone?

programme.title: Conflict Of Interest
programme.desc: Shagun wants to keep the Filmy Weddings business floating and for that she’s willing to go to any lengths. Even if it means shooting a wedding film for Adhira’s ex-boyfriend – Akhil. Adhira is furious and tries her best to sabotage the entire project. Unfortunately, her one big hurdle is Dad, who has taken quite a fondness for Akhil. Check out the episode and find out what happens next!

programme.title: Internal Politics
programme.desc: Adhira and Shagun are in a disagreement about whom to select for a wedding film promo: a boring aunt from the bride's side or a lively drunk aunt from the groom's family. Things take a turn for the complicated when the parents also weigh in with their respective biases.

programme.title: Poaching The Talent
programme.desc: Vishnu, the Agarwal's househelp cum man friday is desired by the sisters as an office boy to help them sort out their business affairs. The parents are naturally opposed to the idea. Thus begins another standoff in the Agarwal household - and Vishnu's position in the house is at stake. Who will finally lay claim over Vishnu's priceless services?

programme.title: Business Secrets
programme.desc: In a footage from a wedding they just filmed, the sisters find a drunken confession from the bride's best friend. It turns out she is the groom's ex - and he hasn't told the bride to be. Caught in the moral dilemma of choosing to tell the bride or not, the sisters find themselves on other ends of the argument. Meanwhile, it is revealed that Adhira's father might have a similar secret hidden from everyone. Will the sisters do the morally right thing or the financially right thing? And what is the father's bizarre obsession with knowing who the groom's mom is?

programme.title: Breach Of Contract
programme.desc: Chasing a competitive business pitch to work for a coveted fashion firm, the sisters are again at different sides of a dilemma. The commitment to the new opportunity would be for a minimum two years, which Adhira is reluctant to make at the age of 25. Whereas Shagun, having already quit her high paying corporate job to join this business, sees no harm in seizing the opportunity with open arms. As their argument turns to a fight, we are left wondering if this is in fact the fight to end all fights. Will the sisters come to the same page and work for the pitch? Or will Happily Hitched disband for good?

programme.title: Arranged Family
programme.desc: Nikhil Solanki arrives at his in-laws' home, where a series of mishaps culminate in a significant blunder that upsets his father-in-law, Prakash Sharma. Both struggle to address the situation openly.

programme.title: The Mad House
programme.desc: Prakash avoids acknowledging that Nikhil damaged his car, instead blaming neighborhood children. Nikhil's attempts to rectify the situation lead to further complications.

programme.title: Conditions Apply
programme.desc: During Sudha and Prakash's anniversary celebration, relatives pose uncomfortable questions, challenging Nikhil's patience and composure.

programme.title: Stuck In The Middle
programme.desc: A disagreement between Anita and her parents results in a cold war, leaving Nikhil caught between his wife and in-laws.

programme.title: Home
programme.desc: Nikhil expresses his feelings of being an outsider within the family, prompting an open discussion aimed at resolving underlying issues.

programme.title: Welcome Home
programme.desc: A few months after moving to Mumbai, Nikhil (Veer Rajwant Singh) and Anita are finally settled. The peace is interrupted by the arrival of Nikhil's parents, Kiran (Shishir Sharma) and Vandana (Renuka Shahane), for a short visit. Anita, ever the perfectionist, is anxious to be the "perfect daughter-in-law," but her efforts are met with a series of awkward and hilarious hurdles.

programme.title: Surprise, Surprise!
programme.desc: The episode picks up with the fallout of Nikhil’s father, Kiran (Shishir Sharma), going missing during his walk in the previous episode. While he eventually returns, the tension doesn't dissipate. The "surprise" of the title is twofold: the unexpected arrival of Nikhil’s sister, Shreya (Kriti Vij), and the unsettling realization that something is physically or mentally "off" with Kiran.

programme.title: Spilling The Beans
programme.desc: The entire family—Nikhil (Veer Rajwant Singh), Anita (Eisha Chopra), Kiran (Shishir Sharma), Vandana (Renuka Shahane), and Shreya (Kriti Vij)—piles into a car to attend a relative's 60th birthday celebration. What was meant to be a joyful getaway becomes a pressure cooker for the long-standing resentment between the siblings.

programme.title: Something's Missing
programme.desc: The title is a poignant double entendre: it refers to a missing set of rings at the family function, but more deeply, it refers to the "missing" pieces of Kiran’s (Shishir Sharma) memory. The facade of a "normal family vacation" finally crumbles, forcing the Solankis to stop pretending.

programme.title: House Of Cards
programme.desc: The title "House of Cards" refers to the fragile "perfect family" image the Solankis have tried to maintain. After the emotional explosion regarding Kiran’s (Shishir Sharma) health and Shreya’s (Kriti Vij) marriage, the "house" has finally collapsed—but in its place, something more honest is being built.

programme.title: Home
programme.desc: In the Season 2 finale, "Home," Anita and Nikhil prepare to move into their own place. The episode resolves the season's friction between Anita and her mother-in-law, replacing awkward formalities with genuine mutual respect. As they move out, the story concludes that "home" isn't about physical space, but the emotional bridge built between two different generations.

programme.title: Circle Of Life
programme.desc: The title "Circle of Life" refers to the poignant role reversal where the children now become the guardians of their parents, mirroring the care they once received.

programme.title: Not Kidding
programme.desc: The episode centers on a visit from Anita’s boisterous, unfiltered parents—Akshata (Deepika Amin) and Kiran Sharma (Shishir Sharma). The quiet, disciplined, and currently somber Solanki household is suddenly upended by the high-energy Sharmas. The primary conflict arises when the two sets of parents have a "polite clash" over how to care for the ailing Kiran Solanki and, more pivotally, the couple's future plans regarding children.

programme.title: Here We Go Again
programme.desc: With the house now fully "merged," Anita (Eisha Chopra) and Nikhil (Veer Rajwant Singh) decide to throw a surprise anniversary party for the "Folks." While their intentions are pure, the episode explores how a "celebration" can quickly become a source of stress when dealing with a chronic illness and interfering relatives.

programme.title: Zor Se Bolo
programme.desc: The episode revolves around a chaotic Sunday at the Solanki household. The central plot involves Kiran Solanki (Shishir Sharma) needing a hearing aid, but it quickly spirals into a larger commentary on how the family members are "deaf" to each other's actual needs and desires.

programme.title: That's All Folks
programme.desc: The finale moves away from the day-to-day bickering and centers on a quiet realization: Nikhil (Veer Rajwant Singh) and Anita (Eisha Chopra) have finally stopped "adjusting" and have started living. The episode focuses on the family accepting their "New Normal" while acknowledging that the road ahead with Kiran’s (Shishir Sharma) health will be challenging but shared.

programme.title: Truth Bombs
programme.desc: The episode begins with Nikhil (Veer Rajwant Singh) and Anita (Esha Chopra) gathering the family for a "serious talk." After months of private deliberation, they drop the ultimate truth bomb: they have decided to adopt a child instead of pursuing a biological pregnancy.

programme.title: The Damaad Test
programme.desc: The episode centers on the Home Study, a critical step in the Indian adoption process where a government social worker visits the family to determine if they are fit to raise a child. However, the title "The Damaad Test" (The Son-in-law Test) refers to the parallel pressure Nikhil (Veer Rajwant Singh) feels to prove he is a "good son" while also being a "good son-in-law" to Anita’s (Eisha Chopra) visiting parents.

programme.title: Ladkiwale Vs. Ladkewale
programme.desc: While Anita (Eisha Chopra) and Nikhil (Veer Rajwant Singh) are stuck in the agonizing "waiting period" of the CARA process, the tension shifts to the two sets of parents. The episode highlights that even when everyone agrees on the goal (the grandchild), their different ways of expressing love and anxiety can lead to a hilarious yet deep-seated cultural clash.

programme.title: Are We Ready?
programme.desc: The wait is over: Anita and Nikhil are matched with a child. However, instead of the pure euphoria they expected, they are hit with a wave of intense anxiety. The title "Are We Ready?" reflects the internal crisis the couple faces as they realize their lives are about to change irrevocably—not in nine months, but in a matter of days.

programme.title: What The Future?
programme.desc: The finale begins with the arrival of the moment Anita (Eisha Chopra) and Nikhil (Veer Rajwant Singh) have spent the entire season preparing for: bringing their adopted daughter home. The episode isn't just about the new arrival, but about how each family member adapts to their "What The Future" role.

programme.title: Comfort Zone
programme.desc: Shaurya struggles with getting recognition for his efforts at work while Sanya debates shifting out of her home. Both of them help each other step out of their comfort zones and grow

programme.title: Time Off
programme.desc: As Shaurya and Sanya shift in together, Sanya takes a gamble at work which impacts both of their lives.

programme.title: Emotion Or Logic
programme.desc: As Shaurya and Sanya deal with the realization of having fallen for each other, they have to prioritize what is more important - emotions or logic?

programme.title: New Roles
programme.desc: Having finally admitted their feelings to each other, Shaurya and Sanya's honeymoon weekend is over and they must get back to reality. With Shaurya up for a promotion and Sanya doubtful about her growth in this company, what is this new couple in for?

programme.title: Milestones
programme.desc: With appraisals around the corner, Shaurya and Sanya brace themselves for the unexpected. Eventually, Shaurya gets his first real lesson in team management and Sanya makes a crucial decision to help her get what she wants.

programme.title: Month-Iversary
programme.desc: To mark 3 months of being together, Shaurya convinces Sanya to organise something for their "monthiversary." However, things begin to get complicated as Shaurya finds himself working directly with Sanya - for the first time since they started dating.

programme.title: Choices
programme.desc: Shaurya eventually ends up at Akhil’s party but to his surprise does not feel like he belongs there. Meanwhile, Ratna invites Sanya to have a drink with her. Sanya still upset about Shaurya lying to her begins to feel better with Ratna and her friends. To her surprise Shaurya shows up there as well to save their monthi-versary. However, things seem to go in the opposite direction soon.

programme.title: Time Off
programme.desc: Shaurya’s presentation does not go as planned and he ends up overpromising samples to the client on a three day deadline. This leads to the team having to work round the clock. Meanwhile, Sanya makes a plan to take a break from work and convinces Shaurya to do go somewhere together. Both Shaurya and Sanya finally spend some quality time with each other but things take a turn when Shaurya gets a call from Vinod.

programme.title: Last Shot
programme.desc: Sanya decides to move back to her room. Shaurya isn’t happy about this. To make things worse Akhil is hard on him for overpromising and almost losing the client. Akhil demands that the team fixes the situation and gets them another chance.

programme.title: Broke Af
programme.desc: The episode sets the stage for the series: Ray and Nikhat are best friends and roommates who have just started their journey into independent adulthood. The central conflict is the classic "End of the Month" crisis—where your bank account is empty, but your social and survival needs are not.

programme.title: Mommy Knows Best
programme.desc: The episode centers on a surprise visit from Nikhat’s mother, which triggers a high-speed cleaning operation. For any young person living away from home, the "parental visit" is a performance of maturity, and Ray and Nikhat are determined to win an Oscar for "Most Responsible Adults."

programme.title: Friends Ya Followers
programme.desc: The episode explores the gap between digital perception and reality. Ray and Nikhat find themselves caught in a cycle of comparing their "boring" lives to the filtered, high-glamour lives of their peers on Instagram.

programme.title: On My Way
programme.desc: The episode follows a high-stakes day for both girls. Nikhat (Aisha Ahmed) is trying to climb the corporate ladder and has a critical presentation, while Ray (Yashaswini Dayama) is dealing with the thrill and anxiety of a potential romantic connection. The title reflects the constant "hustle" and the physical and metaphorical state of being "in transit" in life.

programme.title: Now And Then
programme.desc: The episode is framed around a significant milestone: Nikhat’s (Aisha Ahmed) birthday. While birthdays are usually for celebrating, they often trigger a "Quarter-Life Crisis" where we compare our current reality to the versions of ourselves we imagined "then."

programme.title: Just Kiddin
programme.desc: The episode revolves around the nightmare of moving houses in Mumbai. Ray and Nikhat are excited about their new "adult" space, but the transition from the old house to the new one becomes a comedy of errors that tests their patience and their friendship.

programme.title: Work It Out
programme.desc: The episode explores the "Work-Life Balance" myth. Nikhat (Aisha Ahmed), now in a senior role with a fancy new apartment to pay for, is buried under deadlines, while Ray (Yashaswini Dayama) is trying to figure out how to be a "productive" freelancer without the structure of an office.

programme.title: Me Vs Us
programme.desc: The episode centers on the loss of personal space. As Ray (Yashaswini Dayama) and Nikhat (Aisha Ahmed) spend more time in their new apartment, the "honeymoon phase" of moving in ends. The title reflects the struggle to maintain one’s own identity ("Me") while being part of a co-dependent duo ("Us").

programme.title: Not Cool
programme.desc: The episode centers on the arrival of Ray’s (Yashaswini Dayama) old school friend. Ray is excited to show off her "cool" Mumbai life, her "cool" roommate Nikhat (Aisha Ahmed), and her "cool" new apartment. However, the reunion doesn't go as planned, leading to a major case of "Social Comparison Anxiety."

programme.title: Challenge Accepted
programme.desc: Everything that could go wrong, does. The episode is a "comedy of errors" that quickly turns into an emotional crucible. As the girls juggle professional disasters and personal health scares, they are forced to answer the question: Are we just friends because it’s convenient, or are we family?

programme.title: Pawri Ho Rahi Hai
programme.desc: The episode picks up with Ray (Yashaswini Dayama) and Nikhat (Aisha Ahmed) feeling the absolute peak of urban exhaustion. Between Nikhat’s soul-crushing corporate deadlines and Ray’s chaotic freelance schedule, they realize they are running on fumes. To blow off some steam before their planned trip home, they decide to have one last "epic" Mumbai night.

programme.title: Rat Trap
programme.desc: The episode follows Ray (Yashaswini Dayama) and Nikhat (Aisha Ahmed) as they settle into their respective family homes. The initial "pampering phase" (where parents cook your favorite meals and do your laundry) ends abruptly, replaced by the suffocating routine and expectations they once ran away from.

programme.title: Old Dots, New Lines
programme.desc: While still in their respective hometowns, Ray (Yashaswini Dayama) and Nikhat (Aisha Ahmed) encounter people from their past. The episode highlights the awkward friction that occurs when you realize your old friends have either stayed exactly the same or changed in ways you can no longer relate to.

programme.title: Sisterhood
programme.desc: The episode explores the complex, multi-generational layers of female relationships. It’s not just about the friendship between the two leads, but about the "sisterhood" they share with their mothers and the realization that their mothers were once young, ambitious, and confused women too.

programme.title: Out Of Office
programme.desc: The title "Out Of Office" is a play on their professional status, but it more accurately reflects their mental state. They’ve been "out of office" from their Mumbai lives for long enough to gain a new perspective. The episode focuses on the inevitable departure and the emotional weight of saying goodbye—this time with the maturity of adults who know exactly what they are going back to.

programme.title: Nero The Hero
programme.desc: The episode opens with a camera crew following Neerav Kapoor (Nero) as he prepares for his day. Within the first five minutes, it becomes clear that Nero doesn't just want to be an actor; he believes he is already a legendary craftsman who simply hasn't been "discovered" yet.

programme.title: The Tables Turn
programme.desc: The episode explores the concept of "Networking." Nero believes that his talent is so undeniable that if he can just get in front of the right person, the "tables will turn," and he will go from a nobody to a superstar. This leads him to infiltrate a high-profile industry event where he is, unsurprisingly, not fit.

programme.title: The Agony Aunt
programme.desc: Nero realizes that being a great actor isn't just about performing; it’s about observation and mentorship. He decides to take it upon himself to solve the "emotional blocks" of everyone around him, believing that his vast experience in playing fictional characters makes him an expert in real-world psychology.

programme.title: Superheroes
programme.desc: Nero becomes obsessed with the idea that he is the perfect fit for a "desi" superhero franchise. He doesn't wait for a script or a casting call; he decides to live the life of a superhero to "absorb the essence" of the character. This leads to some of the most cringeworthy "public" moments in the entire series.

programme.title: Getting Functional
programme.desc: Nero becomes convinced that the secret to becoming a superstar lies in "Physical Functionality." He decides that his body needs to be a fine-tuned instrument capable of any physical feat, leading him to join a CrossFit-style gym. However, in true Nero fashion, he doesn't just work out—he turns the gym into a stage for his "performative athleticism."

programme.title: In-House Talent
programme.desc: Nero is faced with a harsh reality: his bank account is empty, and his "blockbuster" hasn't arrived. He decides to grace a small-scale, in-house corporate production with his "legendary" presence. He views this as a charitable act—a superstar helping out the common folk—but the corporate team views him as a total nightmare.

programme.title: Reflections Of Blood
programme.desc: Nero decides that the mainstream industry is too "small-minded" to understand his vision. He takes on the role of Writer, Director, and Lead Actor to produce an avant-garde short film titled Reflections of Blood.

programme.title: Equal Rights
programme.desc: Nero realizes that "socially conscious" cinema is the current trend in the industry. He decides that to be a true "Hero," he needs to stand up for the marginalized. However, because it's Nero, he manages to turn a fight for "Equal Rights" into a self-centered campaign for "Actor’s Rights."

programme.title: High Is Well That Ends Well
programme.desc: The title is a classic Nero-ism—a mangled version of "All's Well That Ends Well," infused with his obsession with "vibrations" and high-frequency living. In this finale, Nero is faced with the ultimate test: a real, high-stakes opportunity that requires him to be... normal.

programme.title: All's Well That Ends Well
programme.desc: The documentary crew follows a rare moment of "crisis" in Nero’s life. His landlord has had enough of the "acting workshops" (noise) and unpaid dues. Nero, however, refuses to see this as a tragedy; he views it as the "Second Act" of his biopic where the hero hits rock bottom before the inevitable rise.

programme.title: Respawn
programme.desc: Arun (Vishal Vashishtha) is a former professional gamer, once known as "Flickshot," who left his passion to work a monotonous corporate job and support his family. When he sees his former teammate, Shekhar, succeeding on a massive stage, his suppressed passion resurfaces. Despite his father’s disapproval and the general stigma surrounding gaming as a career, Arun decides to quit his job and attempt a comeback.

programme.title: A New Beginning
programme.desc: Arun realizes he can’t win alone and begins the hunt for a new team. The episode focuses on the recruitment of a "misfit" squad: Prachi: A badminton player struggling with an injury. Jeetu: A delivery boy with natural, lightning-fast reflexes. Adil: A young, tech-savvy enthusiast who acts as the team's initial bridge. Raunak: A volatile but highly skilled "fragger." The task is harder than Arun anticipated, as he has to convince these individuals (and their skeptical families) that they have what it takes to be pros.99999999999

programme.title: Noobde (noobs)
programme.desc: The team has assembled, but the chemistry is non-existent. Raunak’s ego clashes with the other members, and the group struggles to put their personal issues aside during practice. Arun has to step up not just as a player, but as a coach, to teach them that in Esports, individual brilliance is useless without team synergy. This episode highlights the "grind" of professional gaming and the steep learning curve.

programme.title: Under Pressure
programme.desc: With the tournament only a week away, the pressure reaches a boiling point. Arun’s father discovers he quit his job, leading to a major confrontation. Meanwhile, the team faces a crushing defeat in a practice match against established professionals, leaving their confidence shattered. However, seeing Arun's dedication eventually inspires his father to have a change of heart, and the team finally begins to gel as a unit.

programme.title: Rise Of The Underdogs
programme.desc: The season finale takes place at the Indian Pro Gaming League. Team Clutch enters as the ultimate underdogs. After a shaky start and a brief internal conflict where Raunak almost walks out, the team reunites for a final stand. They reach a thrilling tie-breaker round where they must prove their worth. The series ends with the team securing a victory, using their prize money to chase their individual dreams while planning to build a permanent gaming headquarters.

programme.title: Rangbaaji (the Carefree Persona)
programme.desc: We are introduced to Raviranjan, a small-town guy who balances life as a part-time YouTuber with his status as a "full-time" aspirant. While he acts confident (his rangbaaji), the episode reveals the underlying pressure he faces. He isn’t just seeking a job; he’s seeking the social status required to marry Jyoti. The episode sets up the stakes: it's a battle between his dreams and the harsh deadlines of the competitive exam world.

programme.title: Parishram (the Effort)
programme.desc: The reality check hits hard when the OSC results are announced and Ravi fails his first attempt. He faces taunts from his family and the crushing weight of societal judgment. Encouraged by Jyoti, who provides both emotional support and a strategic plan, Ravi moves from being a "casual" student to a "hardcore" aspirant. This episode highlights the physical and mental "grind" involved in the preparation.

programme.title: Avroh (the Descent)
programme.desc: As the wait for the next exam cycle continues, the "high" of hard work starts to fade into a "low" (Avroh means descent). Financial struggles, family tensions, and unexpected "villains" in the form of societal gatekeepers threaten to derail him. Ravi is forced to make difficult choices between his relationship with Jyoti and his focus on the exam, as the cracks in his mental health begin to show.

programme.title: Prateeksha (the Finale The Wait)
programme.desc: The finale focuses on the most agonizing part of the process: the wait. Ravi faces his final hurdles and a major internal crisis of self-doubt. The episode serves as a powerful commentary on the Indian examination system, exploring whether a job title truly defines a person's worth. It concludes Raviranjan's journey by showing how he manages to reclaim his self-respect (Swabhiman), regardless of the exam result.

programme.title: Humse Na Ho Paayega
programme.desc: The episode sets the stage for the ultimate "Generation Gap" social experiment. Akash (Rohan Shah) and Pooja (Aditi Myakal) are a modern married couple living in a spacious Mumbai apartment. However, their lifestyle is outpacing their income, leading them to a radical decision: renting out their spare rooms to bachelors.

programme.title: Khan-Daan
programme.desc: After the initial adjustment period of the pilot, the household faces its first major logistical crisis—Food. The episode explores the chaos of shared groceries, differing diets, and the "disaster" that is a communal refrigerator.

programme.title: Safai-Squad
programme.desc: After weeks of living together, the apartment has reached a state of "critical mess." Aashna (Kriti Vij), who takes pride in a clean and aesthetic home, finally snaps. The episode follows the couple's attempt to militarize the house cleaning process and the bachelors' hilariously lazy resistance.

programme.title: Family Ban Gayi
programme.desc: The episode begins with a sense of impending change. After weeks of chaos, the experimental living arrangement—where a married couple (Akash and Pooja) shares their home with three bachelors (Rohit, Mohit, and Vishi)—is put to the test.

programme.title: Hotel California
programme.desc: Maya, a Gen Z UX designer, joins Thoda Sukoon — a mental health startup with strict office hours, long workdays, and zero breathing space. Expecting flexibility and support, she instead finds herself caught in a whirlwind of deadlines and old-school hustle. As pressure mounts ahead of a major product launch and funding round, Maya connects with her burnt-out teammates. But when it comes to challenging the system — who’s willing to speak up?

programme.title: The Launch
programme.desc: Tight deadlines. Zero chill. And one very fed-up Maya. Maya’s ideas get ghosted, her dedication’s under the scanner, and the team? Busy minding their own burnout. Just when she finds a bit of empathy, things spiral again. Sleep is a myth, pressure is real, and Maya’s had enough. But when push comes to shove… does she stay, or finally hit CTRL+ALT+ESC?

programme.title: Let's Talk Nutrition with Mugdha Pradhan Part 02 | Difference Between Subcutaneous Fat & Visceral Fat
programme.desc: In this enlightening video, Functional Nutritionist Mugdha Pradhan breaks down the crucial differences between subcutaneous fat and visceral fat, helping you understand their distinct impacts on your health. Subcutaneous fat is the layer found directly under the skin, often noticeable in areas like the abdomen and thighs. While it’s less harmful, managing it is still important for overall fitness. On the other hand, visceral fat lies deeper, wrapping around vital organs and posing significant health risks, including heart disease and diabetes. Mugdha Pradhan offers practical advice on reducing both types of fat through balanced nutrition and lifestyle changes.

programme.title: Let's Talk Nutrition with Mugdha Pradhan Part 02 | Difference Between Subcutaneous Fat & Visceral Fat
programme.desc: In this enlightening video, Functional Nutritionist Mugdha Pradhan breaks down the crucial differences between subcutaneous fat and visceral fat, helping you understand their distinct impacts on your health. Subcutaneous fat is the layer found directly under the skin, often noticeable in areas like the abdomen and thighs. While it’s less harmful, managing it is still important for overall fitness. On the other hand, visceral fat lies deeper, wrapping around vital organs and posing significant health risks, including heart disease and diabetes. Mugdha Pradhan offers practical advice on reducing both types of fat through balanced nutrition and lifestyle changes.

programme.desc: In this enlightening video, Functional Nutritionist Mugdha Pradhan breaks down the crucial differences between subcutaneous fat and visceral fat, helping you understand their distinct impacts on your health. Subcutaneous fat is the layer found directly under the skin, often noticeable in areas like the abdomen and thighs. While it’s less harmful, managing it is still important for overall fitness. On the other hand, visceral fat lies deeper, wrapping around vital organs and posing significant health risks, including heart disease and diabetes. Mugdha Pradhan offers practical advice on reducing both types of fat through balanced nutrition and lifestyle changes.

programme.desc: In this enlightening video, Functional Nutritionist Mugdha Pradhan breaks down the crucial differences between subcutaneous fat and visceral fat, helping you understand their distinct impacts on your health. Subcutaneous fat is the layer found directly under the skin, often noticeable in areas like the abdomen and thighs. While it’s less harmful, managing it is still important for overall fitness. On the other hand, visceral fat lies deeper, wrapping around vital organs and posing significant health risks, including heart disease and diabetes. Mugdha Pradhan offers practical advice on reducing both types of fat through balanced nutrition and lifestyle changes.

Subcutaneous fat is the layer found directly under the skin, often noticeable in areas like the abdomen and thighs. While it’s less harmful, managing it is still important for overall fitness. On the other hand, visceral fat lies deeper, wrapping around vital organs and posing significant health risks, including heart disease and diabetes. On the other hand, visceral fat lies deeper, wrapping around vital organs and posing significant health risks, including heart disease and diabetes. On the other hand, visceral fat lies deeper, wrapping around vital organs and posing significant health risks, including heart disease and diabetes. On the other hand, visceral fat lies deeper, wrapping around vital organs and posing significant health risks, including heart disease and diabetes. programme.desc: In this enlightening video, Functional Nutritionist Mugdha Pradhan breaks down the crucial differences between subcutaneous fat and visceral fat, helping you understand their distinct impacts on your health. Subcutaneous fat is the layer found directly under the skin, often noticeable in areas like the abdomen and thighs. While it’s less harmful, managing it is still important for overall fitness. On the other hand, visceral fat lies deeper, wrapping around vital organs and posing significant health risks, including heart disease and diabetes. Mugdha Pradhan offers practical advice on reducing both types of fat through balanced nutrition and lifestyle changes.

programme.title: Let's Talk Nutrition with Mugdha Pradhan Part 02 | Difference Between Subcutaneous Fat & Visceral Fat
programme.desc: In this enlightening video, Functional Nutritionist Mugdha Pradhan breaks down the crucial differences between subcutaneous fat and visceral fat, helping you understand their distinct impacts on your health. Subcutaneous fat is the layer found directly under the skin, often noticeable in areas like the abdomen and thighs. While it’s less harmful, managing it is still important for overall fitness. On the other hand, visceral fat lies deeper, wrapping around vital organs and posing significant health risks, including heart disease and diabetes. Mugdha Pradhan offers practical advice on reducing both types of fat through balanced nutrition and lifestyle changes.

programme.title: Let's Talk Nutrition with Mugdha Pradhan Part 02 | Difference Between Subcutaneous Fat & Visceral Fat
programme.desc: In this enlightening video, Functional Nutritionist Mugdha Pradhan breaks down the crucial differences between subcutaneous fat and visceral fat, helping you understand their distinct impacts on your health. Subcutaneous fat is the layer found directly under the skin, often noticeable in areas like the abdomen and thighs. While it’s less harmful, managing it is still important for overall fitness. On the other hand, visceral fat lies deeper, wrapping around vital organs and posing significant health risks, including heart disease and diabetes. Mugdha Pradhan offers practical advice on reducing both types of fat through balanced nutrition and lifestyle changes.

programme.title: Let's Talk Nutrition with Mugdha Pradhan Part 02 | Difference Between Subcutaneous Fat & Visceral Fat
programme.desc: In this enlightening video, Functional Nutritionist Mugdha Pradhan breaks down the crucial differences between subcutaneous fat and visceral fat, helping you understand their distinct impacts on your health. Subcutaneous fat is the layer found directly under the skin, often noticeable in areas like the abdomen and thighs. While it’s less harmful, managing it is still important for overall fitness. On the other hand, visceral fat lies deeper, wrapping around vital organs and posing significant health risks, including heart disease and diabetes. Mugdha Pradhan offers practical advice on reducing both types of fat through balanced nutrition and lifestyle changes.

programme.title: Let's Talk Nutrition with Mugdha Pradhan Part 02 | Difference Between Subcutaneous Fat & Visceral Fat
programme.desc: In this enlightening video, Functional Nutritionist Mugdha Pradhan breaks down the crucial differences between subcutaneous fat and visceral fat, helping you understand their distinct impacts on your health. Subcutaneous fat is the layer found directly under the skin, often noticeable in areas like the abdomen and thighs. While it’s less harmful, managing it is still important for overall fitness. On the other hand, visceral fat lies deeper, wrapping around vital organs and posing significant health risks, including heart disease and diabetes. Mugdha Pradhan offers practical advice on reducing both types of fat through balanced nutrition and lifestyle changes.

On the other hand, visceral fat lies deeper, wrapping around vital organs and posing significant health risks, including heart disease and diabetes. Mugdha Pradhan offers practical advice on reducing both types of fat through balanced nutrition and lifestyle changes.

programme.title: Let's Talk Nutrition with Mugdha Pradhan Part 02 | Difference Between Subcutaneous Fat & Visceral Fat
programme.desc: In this enlightening video, Functional Nutritionist Mugdha Pradhan breaks down the crucial differences between subcutaneous fat and visceral fat, helping you understand their distinct impacts on your health. Subcutaneous fat is the layer found directly under the skin, often noticeable in areas like the abdomen and thighs. While it’s less harmful, managing it is still important for overall fitness. On the other hand, visceral fat lies deeper, wrapping around vital organs and posing significant health risks, including heart disease and diabetes. Mugdha Pradhan offers practical advice on reducing both types of fat through balanced nutrition and lifestyle changes.

programme.title: Let's Talk Nutrition with Mugdha Pradhan Part 02 | Difference Between Subcutaneous Fat & Visceral Fat
programme.desc: In this enlightening video, Functional Nutritionist Mugdha Pradhan breaks down the crucial differences between subcutaneous fat and visceral fat, helping you understand their distinct impacts on your health. Subcutaneous fat is the layer found directly under the skin, often noticeable in areas like the abdomen and thighs. While it’s less harmful, managing it is still important for overall fitness. On the other hand, visceral fat lies deeper, wrapping around vital organs and posing significant health risks, including heart disease and diabetes. Mugdha Pradhan offers practical advice on reducing both types of fat through balanced nutrition and lifestyle changes.

programme.title: Let's Talk Nutrition with Mugdha Pradhan Part 02 | Difference Between Subcutaneous Fat & Visceral Fat
programme.desc: In this enlightening video, Functional Nutritionist Mugdha Pradhan breaks down the crucial differences between subcutaneous fat and visceral fat, helping you understand their distinct impacts on your health. Subcutaneous fat is the layer found directly under the skin, often noticeable in areas like the abdomen and thighs. While it’s less harmful, managing it is still important for overall fitness. On the other hand, visceral fat lies deeper, wrapping around vital organs and posing significant health risks, including heart disease and diabetes. Mugdha Pradhan offers practical advice on reducing both types of fat through balanced nutrition and lifestyle changes.

programme.title: Let's Talk Nutrition with Mugdha Pradhan Part 02 | Difference Between Subcutaneous Fat & Visceral Fat
programme.desc: In this enlightening video, Functional Nutritionist Mugdha Pradhan breaks down the crucial differences between subcutaneous fat and visceral fat, helping you understand their distinct impacts on your health. Subcutaneous fat is the layer found directly under the skin, often noticeable in areas like the abdomen and thighs. While it’s less harmful, managing it is still important for overall fitness. On the other hand, visceral fat lies deeper, wrapping around vital organs and posing significant health risks, including heart disease and diabetes. Mugdha Pradhan offers practical advice on reducing both types of fat through balanced nutrition and lifestyle changes.

programme.title: Let's Talk Nutrition with Mugdha Pradhan Part 02 | Difference Between Subcutaneous Fat & Visceral Fat
programme.desc: In this enlightening video, Functional Nutritionist Mugdha Pradhan breaks down the crucial differences between subcutaneous fat and visceral fat, helping you understand their distinct impacts on your health. Subcutaneous fat is the layer found directly under the skin, often noticeable in areas like the abdomen and thighs. While it’s less harmful, managing it is still important for overall fitness. On the other hand, visceral fat lies deeper, wrapping around vital organs and posing significant health risks, including heart disease and diabetes. Mugdha Pradhan offers practical advice on reducing both types of fat through balanced nutrition and lifestyle changes.

Follow our step-by-step guide to create these tasty treats that everyone will love. Don't miss out on this indulgent yet nutritious recipe!

programme.title: Wellness Vardaan By Vidhi Chawla | EP 10 - How to Give Proper Diet and Nutrition to Your Kids - Part 1
programme.desc: Is your picky eater turning mealtimes into a battlefield? This podcast episode is your secret weapon! We will discuss: * Sneaky ways to incorporate essential vitamins and minerals into their favorite foods. * Fun and engaging strategies to make healthy eating a positive experience. * Tips for navigating picky eaters and developing healthy food relationships.

programme.title: Ayurveda with Dimple Jangda Ep 11 - How to Manage Chronic Diseases with Ayurveda
programme.desc: Learn how you can effectively manage chronic diseases through Ayurveda. Expert Dimple Jangda shares how Ayurvedic lifestyle and treatments can provide relief from long-term illnesses. Discover simple Ayurvedic tips, home remedies, and diet plans to help you stay healthy and manage chronic conditions naturally.

programme.title: Ayurveda with Dimple Jangda Ep 04 - What to eat for better digestion?
programme.desc: Ever wondered what to eat for better digestion? Join us as we chat with Dimple Jangda, a top celebrity gut health and Ayurveda coach. She shares simple yet effective Ayurvedic tips and dietary recommendations to improve your digestion naturally. From specific foods to mindful eating habits, Dimple's advice will help you feel your best from the inside out. Don't miss out on these easy-to-follow tips for a healthier gut and a happier you!

programme.title: Let's Talk Nutrition with Mugdha Pradhan Part 04 | Difference Between White Sugar & Brown Sugar I Healthy Alternatives
programme.desc: Confused about the difference between white and brown sugar? Mugdha Pradhan clears the air! Learn how they're made, their nutritional value, and why one might be slightly better than the other. But that's not all! Discover healthier alternatives to satisfy your sweet tooth without the guilt. This video is your go-to guide for making informed choices.

programme.title: Celebrity Fitness Secrets-Richa Chadha
programme.desc: Discover the secrets behind Richa Chadha's diet and fitness regime! In this video, we delve into her balanced diet plan, which includes nutrient-rich foods that fuel her body and promote overall wellness. We also explore her fitness routine to keep her in top shape. Join us as we break down Richa's healthy lifestyle habits that contribute to her incredible physique and vibrant health. Whether you're looking for diet tips, workout inspiration, or a holistic approach to fitness, this video has got you covered!

programme.title: The Apple
programme.desc: Story of two kids and how their life coincides whilst exchanging an Apple. The story reflects the societal dichotomy under the same sky in a small town near Delhi. The film is Accredited in the British Council Global Film directory and quoted by BBC as an "absolutely brilliant thought-provoking film.

programme.title: The Last Act
programme.desc: "THE LAST ACT" follows Chitra, a method actor known for her ability to fully immerse herself into any role. However, as she prepares for her latest performance, she begins to lose touch with reality, seamlessly transitioning between characters and struggling to discern where her performances end and her true self begins.

programme.title: Uyire
programme.desc: 'Uyire' explores the feeling of Love & how differently it is perceived from its actual implied meaning, whilst being a social commentary on the class system that is habitually rooted in Urban cities. Indrajit & Zoya, two contrasting individuals try to find a space where both of them feel respected. The film explores how an individual's upbringing, background, class, responsibilities, shapes their mindset, which ultimately leave Indrajit & Zoya at a stage of uncertainty.

programme.title: The Perception
programme.desc: This story follows the journey of a professional photographer and a poor cycle rickshaw driver in Mumbai at the end of spring. Through various incidents on the road, their perceptions of each other change, highlighting the contrast between their social statuses. Ultimately, their experiences weave together to create a beautiful narrative of understanding and connection.

programme.title: Prowl
programme.desc: A young girl pays a visit to a mysterious stranger after connecting with him through a dating site. What follows is either a cautionary tale or a parable, based on how you view it.

programme.title: Woh Khaas
programme.desc: A business tycoon bored with his monotonous work-life escapes from his corporate setup for a day and ends up meeting a girl, who like a dream changes him upside down in a real ‘Filmy Manner’. Woh Khaas is a jazzy tribute to Bollywood romances that tries to combine the reality of love and the flamboyance of Indian cinema in an entertaining and enriching way.

programme.title: Trp
programme.desc: A victims father tries to get justice for his daughter despite the failed situation system in place.

programme.title: Uljhe Ho Kyun
programme.desc: Fitness influencer Abhay’s quirky habit of messaging his first likes leads him to Srishti, a corporate workaholic. As sparks fly, their contrasting worlds collide in a playful yet unpredictable romance. Will their chemistry sizzle or turn to ashes? A fun, fiery take on modern love.

programme.title: Epicfail
programme.desc: It is difficult to understand the truth about Ramayana in today’s time as it gets lost in translation. This is a film about a young and passionate journalist discovering the truth about Sita.

programme.title: 2 Square
programme.desc: Nikhil comes early after work, and his wife runs to the bedroom where a man is hiding under the bed. She tries to indulge in small talks with Nikhil only to distract him so that her boyfriend can run away. What happens at the end is hilarious.

programme.title: A Tale Of An Onion Witch
programme.desc: Two flatmates, evidently from the gym-going North Indian breed of tinsel-town hopefuls, are warned about the 100 year old Witch that occasionally wanders around at night asking for an Onion. When an attractive neighbour knocks for help at midnight, their red-blooded fates unravel.

programme.title: Avasthana
programme.desc: A Hindi short film revolving around the sad plight of a family who is struggling hard to cope up with everyday expenses. The situation gets so worst that the youngest son robs a chicken from a shop and gets it to the house in spite of them being vegetarians. Watch an emotional journey of this family after the death of patriarchy

programme.title: Baggage
programme.desc: The film is about Sara’s journey as she goes about understanding her role in the greater scheme of things. Sara - who has lost her twin sister to a mysterious vanishing - is trying to come to grips with her loss.

programme.title: Bena
programme.desc: After a set of jewelry goes missing, the police search Bena's bag. Her employers, Bhai and Bhabhi, are shocked to see the contents. They throw her out and Bena spends the day calling people for jobs. The family driver calls Bena and informs her that the set was found. Bena knew that the set would be found as it was misplaced not stolen. Next, she gets a call for a new job. Bena finds out that her employer Bhabhi had recommended Bena. Why was Bena thrown out of her job? What in the bag?

programme.title: Beyond Failing
programme.desc: This film captures intricate nuances of student stress, competition the so called rat race, parent child relation and purposeless living vs. purposeful living.

programme.title: Bhagwaan - The Faith
programme.desc: A final chance meeting with a mysterious old homeless man changes everything they’ve experienced that day. The story delves into how deep their faith truly is and how people worship gods. Some use faith and god as a means of solace while others as a crutch for a troubling life.

programme.title: Bully
programme.desc: In This Psychological Thriller, A girl who is holding her brother hostage must confront the darker aspects of her life and come face to face with the truth.

programme.title: Calling Bell
programme.desc: A psychopath Biriyani Delivery boy barges into the house of a young lady and threatens to kill her. The story revolves around this confrontation between these two characters. The climax of the story turns out to be something very unexpected.

programme.title: Charitra Varnan
programme.desc: A cab driver comes across a woman standing and crying along the roadside. He tries to help her and tells her that he would drop her home safely. What happens next will leave you stunned.

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: We all have a fantastic life but we spoil it with our silly ideas of how to live it. This story is about how in trying to define a relationship, we actually end up confining it. One such definition is marriage and this is what is discussed in Cheers by two intimately close friends - one of whom is helping the other decide against a bad marriage that she has chosen to live with for some time now, thus stifling herself from all the happiness she is entitled to. While the intent of the friend seem questionable, the story is about why she trusts him more than anyone else with this issue that she is facing

programme.title: Destiny's Two
programme.desc: Mohan and his dwarf wife have come to Mumbai from Gujarat for his work. They are a newly wed couple. Their marriage is a compromise, as they do not see the spouse of their imagination in each other. Mohan who gets fascinated seeing taller women realizes the same about his wife. He decides to go to a red light area to fulfill his desire. But does he do it?

programme.title: Dhadkan
programme.desc: Even in this modern era, there are several religious conflicts around us. We start judging a stranger based on his/her religion or culture. This short film is a humble attempt trying to reduce the distance between religions and thereby portraying religious bondage.

programme.title: Doughnut
programme.desc: Sameer, on his afternoon break from work, walks into a restaurant hoping for some quiet time. However, a doughnut with supposedly magical properties has him in for a shock. Fearing the unreal powers he suddenly acquires, he hurries out. How does a young woman who walks in right then change Sameer's attitude towards the magical doughnut?

programme.title: Dry Dreams
programme.desc: We mostly don’t care about things, which we have around us and are easily available here’s one such thrilling short film about a guy who has two visitors asking for water, what happens next is an eye opener.

programme.title: Dum Dum Deega Deega
programme.desc: The solution to your problem is often hidden in the problem itself; all you need is a different outlook. The story of a beggar child, Ajju, who lives on the streets of Mumbai, but dreams big. He challenges his unfortunate fate, with nothing but a 'different outlook' towards the situation he faces.

programme.title: Electric Piya
programme.desc: A high school girl brings a new bulb for her study lamp. The bulb is anthropomorphic and he is exultant and joyful for having the luck of lighting for her. As he lights, he falls in love with the young girl.

programme.title: Exchange Offer
programme.desc: A complaint registered to the manufacturing company for a dead computer brings back nostalgia and surprises in the life of a retired school principle who is living a mundane life.

programme.title: First Sin
programme.desc: What would you do if you unexpectedly obtain magical powers? Ashwath, a failed businessman is having a troubled relationship with his wife . One fine morning he gets a Sand-timer at his door steps. Life takes a turn when he discovers magical powers in it. Will the Sand-timer be a boon or curse ?

programme.title: Hack-her
programme.desc: Shraddha, about to leave for America through a Corporate that is currently under attack by a hacker, who is on run by the police and is currently on every news channel. Between all this is Vishesh, who truly loves Shraddha, and now even she is going, just like his parents, leaving him all alone. But not everything we see is true, a hacker on a mission, a girl with ambitions, and a lover, sounds good right? But who is who? Do we know the entire truth? Find out everything in our upcoming short film "Hack-Her"

programme.title: Holding Back
programme.desc: Short Film Holding back a short film is based on a true incident in 1999, of Shiva, a young man suffering from blood cancer and who, unfortunately, passed away during the journey while traveling by train from Bangalore to Chennai, for a friend’s marriage. Shiva was traveling with his mom and elder cousin Suresh. This film deals with the mother’s emotional journey of her son’s death. The pivotal character- Mother, is played by the national award winner Seema Biswas, popularly known for her role in and as the Bandit Queen; while Father is played by national award-winning director-writer Ananth Mahadevan; Coolie is played by Aditya Lakhia (Kachra) of Lagaan fame; Cousin brother is played by Raj Arjun, main lead in Shabri and Kaalo, Shiva, the son is played by Kunal Kumar with supporting roles played by Marathi theatre and film veterans, Pradeep Patwardhan and Jaywanth Wadekar. Background score is to be given by Anurag Saikia, the national award winner for the music of Yugadrashta in 2014. The camerawork is done by Pushpank Gawade who won the best award for Cinematography for the film Kaalo in South Africa film festival 2012.

programme.title: Housewarming
programme.desc: A short film signifying how the energies we invite into our house affect us.

programme.title: Just Take It Easy
programme.desc: The story is basically on internal happiness. Sanjay a businessman is the CEO of Oberoi Industries. He is not happy in his life. Despite having all the materialistic pleasure not happy internally. The company celebrates its success party on its high growth. Sanjay invites a model Priyanka, his girlfriend to the party. He promises her to make the face of Oberoi Industries.

programme.title: Last Call
programme.desc: When the last conversation between two lovers whose 6-year relationship is on the verge of ending, an attempt has been made to show that words are less and emotions are more.

programme.title: Life 2.0
programme.desc: Life 2.0 is the reflection of modern life, where Humans have become like God. GOD means generator, operator & destroyer but look at us, what are we doing; we are also doing the same.

programme.title: Ludo
programme.desc: Two girls accidentally find out that in addition to the man they unknowingly share, they also share a lot of gifts from him. Including a game of Ludo which resembles their lives in some manner.

programme.title: Make Her Happy
programme.desc: Nandita and Rahul are to be married soon. They are a live-in couple. Things take a U-turn when Rahul gets a call from his ex-girlfriend 'Suhana'. Will Rahul be able to save himself? Watch to find out who has trapped whom.

programme.title: Goals
programme.desc: As Meera, our pretty in pink protagonist comes back to Bombay after spending several months apart from her beau Ranbir, the circumstances force them to evaluate the basis of their relationship. This film is a deep dive into a young adult's core problems of emotional dishonesty and preference of style over substance.

programme.title: Mentoo
programme.desc: A director is accused by an upcoming actress of harassing her and asking her to sleep with him and he would cast her in his next film, these allegations literally destroy his career, but are all allegations always true?

programme.title: 10.30 Lets Go To School
programme.desc: Disha is an ordinary village girl with dreams like any other kid. Not only does she love her father unconditionally, but also her books and school. Life takes an unexpected turn when her Baba and Bua decide to discontinue their education. Her fate is about to meet that of thousands of other children who drop out of school every year. However, it is not so easy to give up. She is intelligent, confident and above all, determined to get back what she rightfully deserves, her right to dream!

programme.title: 13Th Portal
programme.desc: Everyone in the city wants to touch the sky we have to keep running. There is no time to relax, one has to move on or get mowed down. 13th portal talks about a city like that. A city that’s brutal in its ideologies yet accommodates all. The most popular phrase of the people here is, if you come on board we will adjust.

programme.title: A Notice
programme.desc: Notice is a Hindi short film about a couple and the distance which gets created due a loss, it is about the unsaid things in a relationships.

programme.title: A Situation
programme.desc: A widower father, Pradeep has adapted to the challenging life of raising a daughter single-handedly after demise of his wife. One fine morning, she undergoes menstrual bleeding while taking a bath. Helpless and terrified she is locked inside the bathroom, not answering her father. He does not understand what to do next. This film shows that even today, periods stand as the biggest question to a lot of parents.

programme.title: Aakhri Kahani
programme.desc: A struggling writer decides that he's going to make one last effort to pitch his idea to a film producer. He gets the chance to do so in an unusual way when he turns out to be driving a cab that the producer has hired.

programme.title: Aakhri Sawari
programme.desc: Manish, a perfect husband and father, tormented by a mysterious parcel he receives from an anonymous sender has to make a life-changing decision. He shares his problems with his cab driver who listens patiently and tries to help. What the cab driver offers changes both of their lives forever.

programme.title: Abba Ki Chaddi
programme.desc: in Small town where she lives.. Whose husband used to bother her a lot and was responsible for everything, One day suddenly her husband starts fearing her in the name of his father's stick.she does not like his words,makes

programme.title: Tohfa
programme.desc: A gentleman bestowed upon his cherished wife an incredibly valuable and heartwarming present, yet fate had a different plan in store for their journey.

programme.title: ABC
programme.desc: For some people life is about triumph against all odds, for some; life is only about complexities. Some walk through this road aimlessly and some; actually become the bridge. ABC is a short film that showcases the dichotomy between two extreme yet simple individuals. It is an empowering film which has the dexterity & optimism to resonate amongst all sections of audience. As humans, we do tend to forget that we are but one world than just mere economy, that it can just take one human, just one moment, just one action to turn around the paths of millions. ABC; is just a sweet gentle reminder of this thought.

programme.title: Agarbatti
programme.desc: Bhola, who is mentally challenged but still manages to survive by himself, selling incense sticks on the roads. An accident takes place near bhola, he doesn’t see the person clearly who is driving the car. Will he be able to tell the police about this incident?

programme.title: Alvida
programme.desc: Break-ups can be hard, but sometimes they are necessary. Sometimes, you need all your strength to let go and say ... Alvida.

programme.title: An Astrologer's Day
programme.desc: Based on a short story by R.K. Narayan from Malgudi Days. A normal day in the life of an astrologer reveals a lot about him.

programme.title: Arjun
programme.desc: Arjun is a soldier who works more like a mercenary in a never-ending war. He willfully follows the brutal orders of his commanding officer until one day, his entire world turns upside down. Examining one soldier's journey toward redemption, we show that our shared humanity is always worth fighting for underneath the trappings of all that divides us.

programme.title: Arundeep Singh
programme.desc: A man with a speech disorder who even struggles to do his day to day activities will face his greatest fear of dating a woman.

programme.title: Baalak
programme.desc: A film about a girl moving to Kolkata for her new job. She chooses a hotel for overnight stay where an incident makes her realize that life revolves in a circle and carries her emotionally very close to her home and family.

programme.title: Barat
programme.desc: A Typical miser starts picking up a mysterious trail of money only to find out something unearthly lurking around!

programme.title: Bed Tea
programme.desc: Anything can Happen Over a Bed Tea. An unexpected tale of a Rainy Morning which asks a question on a long time going on the existence of hidden evil behavior in relationships.

programme.title: Believer
programme.desc: The story revolves around a young man who is struggling with his career and has to face tough situations on the financial front. In a state of dejection/ despair he has a dialogue with his inner self. His negative self talks him into addictions and resorting to drugs or committin suicide (escapist attitude) He usually feels at home in the company of his negative self and seeks solace here. Yet somewhere he is dissatisfied and constantly looking for his positive self, whom he has only abandoned

programme.title: Beshak
programme.desc: Story of a couple where the wife couldn’t find the difference between dream and reality and doubt enters into the relationship!

programme.title: Betu
programme.desc: Sparsh(12), or Betu, as his mother calls him, is a happy, mischievous boy, who hates milk, who is conscious about his hairstyle and who is too impatient to wait for the lunch hour to eat his best friends tiffin. Sparsh’s life changes when his best friend’s mother dies in an accident. That being his first direct exposure to death, it shakes him up. The unpredictability of life hits him and his mind inadvertently goes to his own mother, who he realizes is not immune from the fickle composition of life. The fear of separation takes away the nonchalance from his attitude and he is no longer the carefree boy he used to be. He starts observing and watching over his mother like a guardian. As he prepares to meet the reality, he is summoned at the destination where his fears lie.

programme.title: Bharam
programme.desc: A Hindi drama short film about an executive visiting a house to give away a Mercedes won by a housewife in a lucky draw and the confusion that follows.

programme.title: Bindu
programme.desc: Bindu, a little school-going girl, and his older brother Gaurav live in the hilly regions where they barely make their day’s end meet. Gaurav works in the early shifts as a paperman, delivering news on his cycle, and finds time in between for Bindu to take her to school. A stitched-up overused shoe, an old ragged school bag, Bindu becomes the epitome of being a struggling unprivileged kid while Gaurav holds on to his pair of old sandals, the same pair of dress, and an old cycle.

programme.title: Blowback
programme.desc: An anxious boy is confused if marijuana helps him with his issues. His quest to answer this dilemma leads him into a night full of corruption and deceit.

programme.title: Blurred Lines
programme.desc: 24-year-old Apoorva is caught in a tangle of relationships when she has an epiphany that she is attracted to her best friend who has come to dress her up to meet prospective in laws.

programme.title: Bumbhaiyya
programme.desc: The movie shows that how a common man is affected by the inter-religious conflicts that happen and how in the end he understands the real truth.

programme.title: Bridge
programme.desc: Mukesh is a widower and has a 28-year-old so Rahul. They live together and rarely talk amicably with each other. Rahul thinks his father is too weird for his age whereas Mukesh thinks why Rahul constantly judges him for his choices.

programme.title: Certitude
programme.desc: This movie shows the story of Arjun, a smalltown boy from Dehradun who decides to move to Mumbai for his further studies. So in his new surroundings, he is unable to trust anyone until he finds someone whom he can finally rely on throughout his journey in Mumbai.

programme.title: Chaar Pandrah
programme.desc: A suspense film about a military guy meeting a Stanger at the bus stop who asks him to stay at his house for the night, as he has a wrong ticket and his house is very far. But he starts to have strange feeling about the strangers wife.

programme.title: Choices
programme.desc: Ritesh and Yami are just a day away from their marriage, and ritesh makes a confession which may affect their upcoming relationship, or maybe not?

programme.title: Cratch
programme.desc: When two individuals coming from two different parts of society with completely distinctive thought processes COLLIDE there would be Chaos, Confusion & a lot of disagreement, but would there ever be an eye-opening conversation? Watch this short to find out Kamrul's unique take on Life and how it affects Manay's perception towards it.

programme.title: Dawn To Dusk
programme.desc: Dawn to Dusk tells the narrative of Nisha Rawat, a young girl who lost her parents. She has skin cancer, Malignant Melanoma and her entire life revolves around the night. Nisha accepted her circumstances as they were. Her life, however, is turned upside down when she meets Suraj, a boy who works at a hospital. Dawn to Dusk becomes Nisha and Suraj's narrative.

programme.title: Days Left Behind
programme.desc: A man struggles to survive in a post-apocalyptic India where the World has been devastated by a deadly virus that turns people into wild cannibalistic creatures, until one day he comes across an abandoned car.

programme.title: Didi!
programme.desc: Imagine waking up to an annoying alarm sound. Familiar? Now imagine waking up to someone else's alarm! Why isn't anyone shutting it? Find out what happens when an annoyed brother wakes up to his sister's loud alarm and storms to her room only to find it empty.

programme.title: Didi!
programme.desc: Imagine waking up to an annoying alarm sound. Familiar? Now imagine waking up to someone else's alarm! Why isn't anyone shutting it? Find out what happens when an annoyed brother wakes up to his sister's loud alarm and storms to her room only to find it empty.

programme.title: Desh Ki Pardesh ?
programme.desc: The film follows the Parikh's on their visit to their children settled in the US. However, to only realize that there's a lot more than just a generation gap between them. Mainly, dawning upon Hasmuk Parikh's that it's great to dream big for your children, but one must be mentally prepared that those dreams may or not have them in it.

programme.title: Dhoop Haskar Boli
programme.desc: A determined daughter walks into a matrimonial office with her quiet, circumspect mother. What follows next is an awkward conversation with a charming executive and an inward journey for all three.

programme.title: Dhoop Haskar Boli
programme.desc: A determined daughter walks into a matrimonial office with her quiet, circumspect mother. What follows next is an awkward conversation with a charming executive and an inward journey for all three.

programme.title: Dimming Shadows
programme.desc: The husband and wife both suffer from dementia, but with the help of a compassionate doctor and nurse, they make an effort to recover. Unfortunately, their attempts are unsuccessful, but their daughter finds solace in visualizing her parents as alive through virtual reality

programme.title: Dimming Shadows
programme.desc: The husband and wife both suffer from dementia, but with the help of a compassionate doctor and nurse, they make an effort to recover. Unfortunately, their attempts are unsuccessful, but their daughter finds solace in visualizing her parents as alive through virtual reality

programme.title: Double Blind

programme.title: Hmm
programme.desc: It all begins at a midnight bus stop, where a girl finds herself unsettled due to a stranger boy's attempts to comfort his girlfriend over a phone call. When his efforts prove unsuccessful, he starts conversing with the girl instead. Despite her apparent reluctance to engage, the boy persists in his conversation, much like a bee unwilling to leave a flower. As the night unfolds, these two unfamiliar individuals end up walking home together. Along the way, they delve into profound discussions about love and relationships. The culmination arrives in a meticulously orchestrated surprise, adding a climactic twist to their journey.

programme.title: A Tale Of An Onion Witch
programme.desc: Two flatmates, evidently from the gym-going North Indian breed of tinsel-town hopefuls, are warned about the 100 year old Witch that occasionally wanders around at night asking for an Onion. When an attractive neighbour knocks for help at midnight, their red-blooded fates unravel.

programme.title: Aplam Chaplam
programme.desc: Jayantika Sengupta: Rani Rahaao: Villain Zoya Sheikh: Child Sundeep Kumar: Son Vikar Tiwari: Friend of a son Sikandar Agarwal: Transgender

programme.title: Aakhri Kahani
programme.desc: A struggling writer decides that he's going to make one last effort to pitch his idea to a film producer. He gets the chance to do so in an unusual way when he turns out to be driving a cab that the producer has hired.

programme.title: Ban Chor
programme.desc: A thief sneaks into a wealthy home for an easy heist—only to find the wife’s secret lover already there! But when the husband arrives, the thief and the lover must hide together, leading to a night of pure chaos, panic, and comedy. Because in this house… "Har chor pe ek mor hota hai!"

programme.title: Ae Ajnabi
programme.desc: Pappu, a misunderstood dreamer, carries a ring for the unknown—waiting for love, waiting for meaning. On a fateful night, he meets Chandini, a mysterious stranger who changes his world in just five hours. As they share stories, laughter, and heartbreak, Pappu finds answers he never knew he needed. But was she ever real? Or just a gift from the sun? A poetic journey of love, loss, and destiny.

programme.title: A Situation
programme.desc: A widower father, Pradeep has adapted to the challenging life of raising a daughter single-handedly after demise of his wife. One fine morning, she undergoes menstrual bleeding while taking a bath. Helpless and terrified she is locked inside the bathroom, not answering her father. He does not understand what to do next. This film shows that even today, periods stand as the biggest question to a lot of parents.

programme.title: Adarniya Mantri Ji
programme.desc: In a gripping tale, Finance Minister Supriya Chaudhry leads a crackdown on black money with her secretary, Laxman. After seizing 1200 crores, they discover 600 crores are missing. Laxman uncovers a secret plan, revealing himself as the masked figure holding the bank manager hostage. As chaos ensues and the truth unfolds, Laxman informs Supriya of their covert success, leaving viewers with a tense cliff hanger. The story ends with the title Adarniya Mantri Ji, leaving the mystery unresolved.

programme.title: Baalak
programme.desc: A film about a girl moving to Kolkata for her new job. She chooses a hotel for overnight stay where an incident makes her realize that life revolves in a circle and carries her emotionally very close to her home and family.

programme.title: Aakhri Sawari
programme.desc: Manish, a perfect husband and father, tormented by a mysterious parcel he receives from an anonymous sender has to make a life-changing decision. He shares his problems with his cab driver who listens patiently and tries to help. What the cab driver offers changes both of their lives forever.

programme.title: Avasthana
programme.desc: A Hindi short film revolving around the sad plight of a family who is struggling hard to cope up with everyday expenses. The situation gets so worst that the youngest son robs a chicken from a shop and gets it to the house in spite of them being vegetarians. Watch an emotional journey of this family after the death of patriarchy

programme.title: 23 B Raheja
programme.desc: 23B Raheja is a gripping one-night drama that peels back the glossy layers of the entertainment industry to expose the shadows lurking beneath. The story revolves around a celebrated casting director whose charm masks a long trail of manipulation and exploitation. His power begins to crumble when a young woman arrives at his door, posing as an aspiring actress—but with a haunting connection to his past. As the night unfolds, so does a tense game of revelations, where truth becomes confrontation and justice takes an unexpected form. Taut, timely, and unsettlingly real, 23B Raheja is not just a story of reckoning—it’s a mirror held up to the systems we too often ignore.

programme.title: Bahaar
programme.desc: Bahaar follows a young woman’s silent suffering inside a marriage built on expectations. Her dreams fade as she’s shamed for infertility—until the family finds a “solution.” A haunting story of societal pressure, dignity, and the myth of the perfect marriage.

programme.title: 2 Square
programme.desc: Nikhil comes early after work, and his wife runs to the bedroom where a man is hiding under the bed. She tries to indulge in small talks with Nikhil only to distract him so that her boyfriend can run away. What happens at the end is hilarious.

programme.title: Ruk Jana Nahi
programme.desc: Rinku, a 28-year-old man living with his father, has lost his will to live. However, a wedding in his neighbourhood brings a constant stream of visitors who unknowingly delay his plans and ultimately restore his will to live and succeed.

programme.title: Anu Aur Di
programme.desc: Late at night, an angry girl had a fight with her boyfriend and called her sister. She had a big suitcase when her sister picked her up in the car. During the drive, they argued and brought up old problems. Things got worse, and the older sister pushed the younger one against the car window in anger. Their argument stopped suddenly when police lights flashed in the dark, and officers pulled them over. The air was tense with anticipation. What would come to light during this unexpected encounter with the police?

programme.title: Annie
programme.desc: Annie, who had recently experienced the loss of her unborn child, crosses paths with an enigmatic homeless man one evening. Unbeknownst to her, that meeting was on the brink of altering her life permanently.
